usage: icebath monitoring [-h] {status} ...

Gateway monitoring: service health metrics plus redacted diagnostics, exported over OTLP to an
operator-configured endpoint. Content-free by construction — no prompts, messages, tool
args/results, or usage analytics. Configure under monitoring.* in config.yaml.

positional arguments:
  {status}
    status    Show monitoring settings, export state, and redaction posture

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
